references.author: B{\"u}rkner, Paul-Christian and Gabry, Jonah and Vehtari, Aki
references.title: Efficient leave-one-out cross-validation for {Bayesian} non-factorized normal and {Student-t} models
references.reading_scope: Publisher metadata and relevant normal conditional-deletion equations, plus official loo implementation vignette. Not a claim to have read every case-study passage.
references.role_in_review: Conditional deletion for a correlated Gaussian outcome; the current study uses two-row physical-pair blocks.

claims.claim: Non-factorized normal models permit exact conditional-deletion means and variances using the precision matrix.
claims.locator: Publisher section 2.1 and official loo vignette LOO-CV for multivariate normal models
claims.limits: The two-row block is derived and checked here. It does not validate the pavement model, latent mean calibration or causal interpretation.

references.author: Vehtari, Aki and Simpson, Daniel and Gelman, Andrew and Yao, Yuling and Gabry, Jonah
references.title: Pareto Smoothed Importance Sampling
references.reading_scope: Primary journal metadata and abstract; implementation and approximation limits checked against official loo documentation.
references.role_in_review: Stabilized importance weighting and reliability diagnostics, with exact fallback rather than omission.

claims.claim: PSIS stabilizes importance weights and provides tail and effective-sample-size diagnostics.
claims.locator: JMLR abstract; official loo psis reference and non-factorized vignette exact-refit discussion
claims.limits: The study-specific ESS400 rule is a declared conservative gate, not a universal paper theorem; all unreliable blocks are exactly refitted.
